Review Google Calendar?

Reviewers describe Google Calendar as a dependable default that fades into the background because it works. They repeatedly praise its clean interface, easy color-coding, reminders, shared calendars, strong sync across devices, and tight links with email, meeting tools, and other apps. Time zone handling stands out as especially reliable for cross-region scheduling. One user notes a small limitation around Google Tasks colors. Feedback from the makers of Sunrise and readywhen reinforces its broad adoption and usefulness as a system other tools build on.

Review beehiiv?

Reviewers mostly see beehiiv as an easy, effective newsletter platform with a strong editor, clear analytics, smooth migration, and useful growth and monetization tools. Several users say it improves engagement and lowers the friction of publishing. But the praise is not universal: some users report limited landing page and editing options, pressure toward paid plans, weak community support versus Substack, limited automations, and poor support when problems arise. Makers of SafetyWing and HeyNews specifically praise its referral system and API access.
